R.title: The Revenant (the survivor's own corpse, risen)

items.concept: The Drowned Return. Same bald skull, coat and lantern hand as the lantern-bearer, but river-rotted: ribs through the coat, weed-green trousers, slack jaw. The lantern is cracked and dead, with cold blue glass and no flame.
items.flavor: You held the light so long you forgot you were the thing it was meant to keep away. The river gave you back. It always does. It just keeps the parts it likes.

items.concept: The Lantern Heart. Upright and the closest match to the anchor's silhouette, but the lantern now hangs inside the open ribcage, burning pale white. Hands are empty claws, legs are wrapped in grave cloth, and the head is tilted wrong.
items.flavor: They buried you with your lantern because nobody wanted to touch it. Now it beats. Six beats a minute. The same as yours, the last time anyone counted.

items.concept: The Crawler. Low on one knee and one hand, it drags itself forward with the lantern still lit and dripping black oil. Two amber pinpoints sit in the sockets. A low silhouette, so it reads differently from the grunts in combat.
items.flavor: It is still looking for the door you were looking for. It is very patient. It has nothing but time and one hand and the same idea you had, which was a bad idea, which is why it is crawling.
